estimand_for_later_stage: Paired change in local-ancestry labels and boundary error when minor alleles with MAC >= 2 and MAF < 0.01, defined only in an independent frequency pool, are added to the same common-marker LAI baseline and compared with a spatially matched equal-count marker control.

software.ancestry_engine: msprime DTWF for 50 generations followed by StandardCoalescent
software.mutation_rate_source: AmericanAdmixture_4B18 catalog value from Gravel et al. 2011

region.coordinate_policy: Rebase bp and cM to zero for simulation and restore the GRCh38 bp offset in exported files. Do not extrapolate outside the authenticated map interval.

source_populations.interpretation: Generic source populations in the published AmericanAdmixture_4B18 model. ASIA is not NAM and must never be relabelled as NAM.
source_populations.rationale: Use the published scenario's own pulse time and proportions instead of combining DNABR proportions with an Asian proxy.

frequency_diploids.purpose: Estimate AC, AN, minor allele, MAC and MAF only.
frequency_diploids.arithmetic: AN=600; MAC 2-5 satisfy MAF<0.01 and MAC 6 does not. Counts preserve the published 1/6, 1/3, 1/2 mixture exactly.

pools.disjunction: FREQ, REF_LAI and DONOR are disjoint source nodes and haplotype fingerprints. TARGET is constructed only from DONOR and is never used to estimate frequency or select sites.
pools.donor_reuse_policy: At each recombination event choose a new donor haplotype without replacement within the seed. Stop if any ancestry exhausts its donor pool.

rare_definition.statistics: Recompute AC and AN from phased genotypes; orient the encoded allele to the minor allele rather than assuming ALT is minor.
rare_definition.target_independence: A selected site remains selected even when absent from all targets. Target genotypes and truth cannot filter or rank sites.

mosaic_generation.event_process: For each target haplotype, draw recombination events as a Poisson process with mean pulse_generations times the map length in Morgans.
mosaic_generation.event_action: At every event redraw ancestry from the frozen mixture and always change donor haplotype. Record an LAI boundary only when the ancestry label changes; retain silent within-ancestry donor switches in the audit trail.
mosaic_generation.truth: Half-open segments cover each target haplotype from start_bp through end_bp without gaps or overlaps; adjacent segments with the same ancestry are merged only in the exported LAI truth.

seeds.role_seeds: Derive distinct ancestry, mutation, pool-allocation and mosaic seeds with numpy.random.SeedSequence; write all derived values to provenance.
seeds.interpretation: Both are technical smoke seeds and are permanently excluded from later DEV and TEST inference.

gates.S0_MAP: Map hash, chr22 interval, strictly increasing bp, non-decreasing cM and coordinate restoration are exact.
gates.S1_REPRODUCIBILITY: Pinned software and the same root seed reproduce byte-identical scientific outputs; changing the seed changes at least the tree sequence or mosaics.
gates.S2_DISJUNCTION: No source node or haplotype fingerprint crosses FREQ, REF_LAI and DONOR; donor selection does not reuse a haplotype within one seed.
gates.S3_PHASE_AND_TRUTH: All exported genotypes are phased and biallelic; truth covers 100 percent of both haplotypes of every target without gaps or overlaps; silent recombinations are not counted as LAI boundaries.
gates.S4_RARENESS: AC, AN, minor orientation, MAC and MAF reproduce exactly from FREQ; every selected site has MAC 2-5 and MAF<0.01; no target or truth value enters selection.
gates.S5_EXPOSURE: Report rare-site count, MAC spectrum, carrier ancestry, rare markers represented in REF_LAI and DONOR, markers per true tract and transitions by ancestry. Each ancestry must have non-zero median observable rare evidence per true tract.
gates.S6_SCOPE: No LAI program, model fitting, performance comparison, error injection, NAM claim or TEST opening occurs in this stage.

stop_rule: Any failed gate stops before LAI. Do not replace a failing seed, relax rare thresholds or inspect performance. A design correction requires a new preregistration version and a new technical smoke.

later_comparator_not_yet_authorized.replication_plan_candidate: 10 DEV seeds and 20 sealed TEST seeds; the seed is the independent unit. This requires a separate PRE after the smoke and resource benchmark.
